description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractQueryLiveCommand' that serves as a base implementation for live command classes wrapping 'ThingQueryCommand' objects, providing methods to access command details and categorize the command as a query.

classes.name: AbstractQueryLiveCommand
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for live commands that wrap 'ThingQueryCommand' instances, facilitating querying of things within a live command framework.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing entity associated with this command.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the selected JSON fields for this query, if any.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command, which is 'QUERY'.
